name: agent-2-sourcing-scout-v1

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent.run_logs (
  id,
  run_id,
  agent,
  status,
  started_at,
  metadata
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $1,
  $2,
  'started',
  $3::timestamptz,
  $4::jsonb
);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.runId }},{{ $json.agentName }},{{ $json.startedAt }},{{ JSON.stringify({ workflowVersion: $('Generate runId').item.json.workflowVersion, model: 'gpt-5.4', reasoningEffort: 'low', cron: '0 11 * * 1' }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent.run_logs
SET
  status = 'failed',
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::int,
  errors_count = 1,
  metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb
WHERE run_id = $1 AND status = 'started';

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Generate runId').item.json.runId }},{{ JSON.stringify({ error: ($json.error && $json.error.message) || $json.message || 'sourcing-scout /run unreachable or non-2xx', source: 'n8n_http_request', failedAt: $now.toISO() }) }}

description: Sourcing Scout (A2) v1: cron Lunes 11:00 UTC, genera runId, abre run_logs started, POST sourcing-scout:8080/run, loguea counts; rama de error cierra run_logs failed. INACTIVO hasta desplegar el contenedor.
